look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Alternate pinnate leaves with many paired narrow leaflets; large unequal yellow petals and dark stamens; narrow flattened legume. Check petiolar nectar gland in a future macro.
taxonomy_notes: Accepted Chamaecrista fasciculata (Michx.) Greene; Cassia fasciculata is a synonym. Distinct from Chamaecrista nictitans.

project_inclusion.notes: No county PASS inferred; no invasive claim.

morphology_keys.habit: Branching annual legume with slender stems; whole-plant photo needed.
morphology_keys.leaves_attachment: Alternate pinnate leaves with paired narrow leaflets; petiolar extrafloral nectary needs macro.
morphology_keys.flower_reproductive: Unequal bright yellow petals and dark stamens, rather than flower color alone.
morphology_keys.fruit_seed: Long flattened legumes that split at maturity, releasing multiple seeds.
morphology_keys.stem_bud: Slender branching stems and stipules; closeup needed.

confused_with: Chamaecrista nictitans: usually smaller flowers and leaflets; compare floral size and leaflet count.
Senna obtusifolia: fewer broader leaflet pairs and different pod structure.
comparisons.key_distinctions: Pinnate leaflets plus conspicuous asymmetric flowers and narrow flat pods.
